title: Material Blend 2-Mix Solo #03 (크리스탈+스테인드글라스)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 40s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, long sleek jet-black hair cascading past hips — her LEFT side is dominated by topaz crystal clusters growing directly out of her own skin, erupting in true three-dimensional relief, each facet casting its own hard shadow, BLAZING TOPAZ ORANGE crystal points, VIVID BRONZE mineral veins. Her RIGHT side is dominated by solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC MAGENTA and VIVID SILVER panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. Rather than a sharp boundary, the two materials interweave and overlap gradually across a soft irregular zone a few inches wide down the centre of her body, elements of each scattered into the other's territory, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: standing full height, both arms slightly spread commanding the frame, both halves of her body clearly visible — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever zone that hand falls in.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every material and every blended transition. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
